summary: Backend-only regression run focused on the reported cart-clear-after-order bug. Wrote pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering: (1) cart is empty (both via GET /api/cart and direct MongoDB check) after a successful COD POST /api/orders, (2) explicit DELETE /api/cart?clear=true clears the cart, (3) SEO endpoints /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml, (4) owner-only PDF download route /api/orders/[id]/download (401 unauth, PDF for owner, PDF for admin), (5) admin download route /api/admin/orders/[id]/download (401/403 for anon and customer, PDF for admin), (6) regression on /api/products, /api/categories, /api/orders/track. All 13 tests PASSED against the external preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: app/api/cart/route.js GET returns 200 even on server error (swallows exception) — good UX but hides real Mongo issues; consider logging.
app/api/orders/route.js sends the confirmation email fire-and-forget (sendOrderConfirmation(...).catch); errors are only logged. Acceptable but consider a background queue for retry.
Confirmation email verified to NOT contain any '/api/admin/orders/*/download' link (grep clean) — security regression check passes.
test_credentials: customer@example.com / User@123 and admin@example.com / Admin@123 (OTP fetched from db.otps via mongosh)
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded customer, admin, and product (slug: test-bakhoor-burner). One COD order was created by the test as part of the cart-clear flow; its id is captured in-memory only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py are pytest-based and reusable. They rely on mongosh (available at /usr/bin/mongosh) to pull the latest login OTP for customer/admin. Base URL is read from TEST_BASE_URL env var, defaulting to the preview URL. To rerun: `cd /app && pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. The cart-clear-after-order bug fix (POST /api/orders now clears CartModel server-side) is verified both via GET /api/cart returning empty items and direct Mongo read of the carts collection.
rca of the issue: Reported: after placing an order, the cart briefly cleared then repopulated because CartDrawer.tsx re-hydrates from server on open/auth change. Root cause: POST /api/orders was not clearing the server-side Cart document, so the next GET /api/cart returned the pre-order items. Fix applied by main agent: after successful order creation, CartModel.findOneAndUpdate({user},{ $set:{ items:[] }}) is invoked (idempotent, best-effort .catch). Additional defensive DELETE /api/cart?clear=true call from checkout. Verified by test_cart_cleared_after_cod_order: after 201 from POST /api/orders, GET /api/cart returns items:[] and db.carts document for the user has items.length == 0.
